title: athyrium filix-femina
intro: Athyrium filix-femina, commonly known as lady fern, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Athyrium genus, native to North America and Europe. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of lady fern include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and soothe respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Athyrium filix-femina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
